test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 15 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following Ministries introduced the Venture Capital Assistance Scheme?

options.text: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Venture Capital Assistance Scheme is an initiative by the **Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare**.
 
• The scheme aims to provide financial support to **agripreneurs** to establish agri-business projects.
 
• It assists the **agriculture sector** in obtaining necessary capital for their business projects.
 
• The scheme encourages **entrepreneurship** in agriculture by providing venture capital to set up agri-business ventures.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Venture Capital Assistance Scheme**

 
 
• The scheme is implemented by the Small Farmers' Agri-Business Consortium (SFAC).
 
• It provides financial assistance to agripreneurs in the form of equity grant or venture capital.
 
• The scheme aims to promote the creation of agri-business projects by providing financial support for the establishment of such projects.
 
• The financial assistance under this scheme is available to eligible agripreneurs, Farmers' Producer Organizations (FPOs), and other agri-business projects.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare**
 
 
• The Ministry is responsible for the formulation and implementation of national policies and programs aimed at achieving rapid agricultural growth.
 
• It focuses on the development of agriculture and allied sectors, including horticulture, animal husbandry, and fisheries.
 
• The Ministry works towards ensuring food security and doubling farmers' incomes by implementing various schemes and initiatives.
 
• Some of the key schemes under the Ministry include Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY), Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchai Yojana (PMKSY), and Kisan Credit Card (KCC) scheme.
 
 
 
• **Small Farmers' Agri-Business Consortium (SFAC)**
 
 
• SFAC is an autonomous society promoted by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare.
 
• It aims to facilitate agri-business projects by providing assistance in the form of venture capital, equity grant, and other financial support.
 
• SFAC plays a crucial role in linking farmers to markets by promoting the formation and strengthening of Farmers' Producer Organizations (FPOs).
 
• It also works towards the development of value chains for various agricultural commodities.
